description: Behavioral contract for all STE-Code pipeline workers. Load this alongside rails.json. Together they define what a worker must do, must not do, and how it reports state.
must-do: Read the prompt file for this worker before starting
Write output to the exact path specified in the prompt
Verify output file exists and is non-empty after writing
Report state in .hermes/exchange/ after each turn
Commit after every 3-worker batch using the specified message format
must-not-do: Summarize, paraphrase, or reorganize source content (extraction stage)
Invent examples, terms, or facts not present in source
Skip a worker and continue to the next batch silently
Proceed to the next stage without gate verification
Use truncation markers (..., [...], etc.) as substitutes for omitted content

recovery-protocol.on-gate-fail: halt pipeline — do not start next stage — write audit/gate-{N}-blocked.md
